title: Observed temperature and moisture at three regional airports
product: NOAA Global Historical Climatology Network hourly (GHCNh)

method.pairing: Both readings must be in the same station/timestamp row, with routine FM15 report type and accepted quality/source codes for each value.
method.quality_policy: Conservative project policy: retain explicitly good documented legacy QC only. Blank/unclassified, suspect, erroneous, gross-limit-only, validator-edited and other codes are excluded, even when NOAA may accept a flagged value. This is not a claim that excluded values are wrong.
method.hour_selection: At most one eligible FM15 pair per UTC clock hour; select the minute closest to :51, the observed modal routine report minute at all three stations; ties choose earlier timestamp. No averaging, interpolation, or special-report substitution.
method.coverage: Selected paired samples divided by all UTC hour bins in the calendar year/month. A represented hour is one sampled moment, not complete continuous coverage.
method.hot_run: A descriptive project threshold of dry-bulb temperature ≥30°C at selected samples in at least three consecutive UTC hour bins. Missing/invalid hours or a cooler sample end a run. This is not an official heat-wave definition or continuous exposure duration.
method.episode_order: Top three qualifying runs per station-year, ordered by peak selected temperature, then number of consecutive bins, then start time. All selected observations remain in the local audit CSV.
method.peak_ties: Among selected paired observations, count every tie for the station-year maximum and display the earliest UTC observation. Its coincident companion reading belongs to that timestamp; it may differ at other tied maxima.
method.quantiles: Type-7 linear empirical sample quantiles, rounded to the underlying 0.1°C reporting precision. Quantiles are descriptive, not engineering design percentiles.
method.physical_guard: Exclude non-finite/sentinel/out-of-sanity-range values and pairs with dew point greater than dry-bulb temperature; no substitution.
method.central_park: Not included; this supplemental acquisition intentionally covers the three verified airport stations only.

limitations: Airport outdoor observations are regional context, not measurements at a selected property or inside a building.
Five complete requested calendar years have small reported gaps after conservative filtering; this is not a 30-year climate normal or an engineering design-weather series.
Dew point adds observed atmospheric-moisture context. These records alone do not establish latent cooling load, electrical capacity, equipment size, operating cost, health risk, or site suitability.
All sample timestamps are UTC. UTC calendar boundaries differ from New York local dates; values were not shifted to local-day summaries.
No climate-change attribution, synthetic future hourly weather, interpolation, heat index, wet-bulb estimate, or load model is produced.
Source data may be revised. Each station-year source URL, retrieval time, Last-Modified value, and SHA-256 hash is retained.
Legacy ISD/Global Hourly stopped updating after August 24, 2025. This consistent 2021–2025 acquisition uses NOAA’s GHCNh successor instead.
